name: Onyx Action Receipt
tagline: The evidence layer for the agentic web. Fills the post-execution evidence gap where ERC-8183 commerce lifecycle ends.
description: Signed cryptographic envelope binding an agent payment to a physical-world or MCP-side side-effect. Outer signature pair (agent + facilitator) Ed25519 over canonical JSON. Side-effect carried as evidence with tier 1..3. Hourly Merkle-root anchored to Base mainnet via EAS.

complementary_to.name: ERC-8004
complementary_to.ar1_relation: consumes — AR-1 receipts reference agent identities by did:web or ERC-8004 agentId

complementary_to.name: ERC-8183
complementary_to.ar1_relation: AR-1 is the canonical reason-hash payload format that 8183 evaluators point at. AR-1 fills the evidence layer 8183's commerce-lifecycle ends at.

complementary_to.name: ERC-8150
complementary_to.ar1_relation: adjacent layer — 8150 verifies pre-pay authorization; AR-1 attests post-execution evidence

complementary_to.name: x402
complementary_to.ar1_relation: AR-1 carried as an x402 response extension; first AR-1 emitter compatible with x402 + AP2

complementary_to.name: AP2 (Google Agent Payments Protocol)
complementary_to.ar1_relation: AR-1 mirrors AP2 PaymentMandate fields (payment_mandate_id, payment_details_id, amount). First AR-1 emitter compatible with AP2 (2026-05-21).

positioning.the_stack: ERC-8004 (identity) -> ERC-8150 (pre-pay ZK) -> x402/AP2 (settlement) -> AR-1/VAR (evidence) -> ERC-8183 (commerce lifecycle terminal state)

signature_alg: Ed25519 over RFC 8785 JCS canonical JSON (A2A v1.2 compatible)
outer_carriage: x402 v2 response extension action-receipt (proposed, PR target: x402-foundation/x402)
ERC-8183 reason-hash payload (proposed, Magicians draft route)

anchor.ar1_schema: bytes32 receiptHash, bytes32 targetHash, string region, uint64 executedAt, bytes32 evidenceHash, uint8 evidenceTier
anchor.batch_schema: bytes32 merkleRoot, uint32 leafCount, uint64 anchoredAt, string version

did_format: did:web (preferred, w3c standard) — legacy did:onyx accepted

gsm.handset_attestation.label: Android Key Attestation co-signed handset proof

bridges.ap2: ap2_bridge.py — ar1_from_ap2_mandate() mirrors AP2 PaymentMandate fields into AR-1 receipt

first_receipt.historical_significance: First AR-1 receipt ever minted. Self-attested compute proof of OAI snapshot.

second_receipt.historical_significance: First AR-1 receipt minted from an AP2 PaymentMandate — first AR-1 emitter compatible with Google AP2.

version_history.change: Initial spec — Ed25519 dual-sign, Merkle anchor, did:onyx
did:web preferred, evidence-tier enum (not 'proof'), JCS canonicalization, ERC-8183/8150 complementarity, AP2 bridge, EAS schema published
